review.notes: Checked all 15 hat definitions twice against authoritative English source. Preserved boolean/hide flags, empty fields, question-mark-only mystery text, slash layouts, and duplicated display-name fields exactly in structure. Names and descriptions received two editorial passes for concise modern Greek, gender-neutral player wording, source humor, and current Island Trader, Mr. Qi, and Foraging terminology.
